transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1966 Wee Lassie Lane?

Yes, this is 1966 Wee Lassie Lane.  
We’re safe, three people here, no water inside, no need for help.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Three people are here. Everyone can come to the phone.

Thanks for letting us know everyone can come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave on their own. No wheelchairs or medical needs here.
Understood, no one needs help leaving. Is there water inside the home right now?
Understood, no water inside and everyone’s safe. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats.
Got it, no truck, no boat, no free seats. Let me read that back: 3 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Three people. No water inside.
Got it, thanks for confirming. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
